what: Evidence that the model-free generator (bin/harnessforge generate and the portal's /generate page), with the fixed Claude Code settings and refuse-only guard hook, runs on real public repositories at pre-registered base commits. It shows what the harness contains and that it is deterministic; it says nothing about whether the harness helps a coding agent.

supersedes.reason: recorded from the generator before the settings/hook fix (43 Read() denies, narrower allow list, no guard hook); every file in this folder was replaced
supersedes.claude_md_unchanged: The four CLAUDE.md files are byte-identical to the old record (same sha256); settings.json, the hooks, manifest and .olivium files changed.

held_out_limit: Only one held-out repository exists in manifest-v2 (pallets/werkzeug). The three held-out subjects are three base commits of that one repository, not separate repositories. 3273 and 3266 produce identical CLAUDE.md text and identical settings and guard files; their exports differ only in the repository profile digest recorded in .olivium/spec.json and .olivium/provenance.json, and so in the manifest and digest.
checkouts: Fresh under scratchpad/real/v3, built with bench/value/arms/olivium_v2.py build_truncated_repo from the cached bare clones (<bench-out>/value-v2-2026-11-09/material/.clones): base_sha and its ancestors only, branch main, no remote, no tags, reflog expired, gc. No instruction files existed at these commits, so none were removed.

product_source.note: Digests computed with bench/value/arms/olivium_v2.py generator_snapshot_digests; identical to the app snapshot the final re-review (settings-review r3/re2) built and tested. The click export here is byte-identical (tree sha256 3dc9aa9f...) to both of that review's click builds.

runtime.mix_build_root: scratchpad/build/record3 (separate from the project _build); 'mix compile' then 'mix assets.build' run there first
runtime.server: Fresh HARNESSFORGE_WORKSPACE (record3/ws/portal), free port 54879, PHX_SERVER=true, started with 'mix run --no-start --no-halt' after setting the endpoint's watchers to [] so the run did not rebuild assets; stopped after the screenshot pass. This is the only difference from 'bin/harnessforge serve'. Server log: no [error] lines.
runtime.cli: bin/harnessforge (mix run) with the same build root; every run in its own fresh workspace; workspace access tokens deleted afterwards and never printed.
runtime.browser: Playwright 1.64.1, Chromium headless shell 156.0.8078.4, viewport 1280x800, device scale 1. The portal renders its own dark theme.
runtime.side_effects_outside_evidence: mix assets.build rewrote the build artifact priv/static/assets/js/app.js (sha256 90e09c41... 1,253,514 B dev-watcher build with inline source map -> 539afc87... 357,275 B); priv/static/assets/css/app.css unchanged (da8e0c3b...). The tailwind 4.3.3 and esbuild 0.25.4 binaries were downloaded into the scratch build root. This recording wrote no other file outside this folder and the scratchpad, ran no Docker container and made no model call.

method.portal: One walkthrough video on werkzeug 3298, then two full screenshot passes over all four checkouts in the same signed-in workspace. Pass 2 is published; pass 1 was superseded only because its CLAUDE.md capture was 568 px wide (its exports are still in the disk proof). In each pass every checkout was generated, the page reloaded and generated again (same-session repeat), then exported to a fresh directory.
method.text_pages: The portal shows .claude/settings.json and the hooks only as names and sizes, so the recorder rendered the exported settings.json and the guard header as plain HTML text pages in the same Chromium (JavaScript off) for werkzeug 3298.
method.image_check: Every image was opened and looked at. The four CLAUDE.md clips were trimmed by 6 px at the bottom to remove a sliver of the export field; nothing else was edited.

limits: Nothing here measures agent cost, context or accuracy; this is generator output only.
The running-stage screenshots are best-effort single frames: the pipeline took 1.1 to 1.9 s from click to ready, and each image shows Detect running.
The click, 3273 and 3266 running-stage frames are byte-identical because the unfocused path field shows only the shared prefix; the DOM facts in proofs/portal-results.json tell them apart.
No Claude Code session was run against these exports in this recording; the guard's behaviour is documented in docs/claude-code-connector.md and the review records, not here.
